support_certificate.proof: Every retained hard signature is heavier than the residual cap. Every omitted signature contains a retained hard support. The three lists partition all original signatures; omitted deficits therefore vanish on every feasible capped selection.
support_certificate.checker_dependency: Standalone integer/set checker in the actual frozen pool_sat.py; no producer or decoder presolve helper is called.

prepared_formula.method: Exact clause, native cardinality, phase and variable-map comparison against original signature supports; no target-coverage enumeration or formula reconstruction.

metadata.proof: Each threshold variable is equivalent to owner multiplicity reaching its threshold. Their weighted sum is total mandatory-support overcoverage. Together with selected-column score losses it is bounded by K*M-sum(weights), using distinct equivalent copies for integer weights. Native negative-column cardinality imposes the packing lower bound, or the full column budget when requested. With exactly K columns the weighted sum equals K*M-sum(weights), so the matching lower cardinality bound is included.
metadata.padding_condition: The optional exact-budget mode preserves covering feasibility by adding unused distinct alternative rows. The caller must remove incompatible canonical unused-column restrictions or verify that at least K permitted columns remain.

scope: All selections of at most 301 blocks from this pinned 663-block finite pool: every common row is forced for any solution with at most 7 holes.

stage_timings.method: Exact clause, native cardinality, phase and variable-map comparison against original signature supports; no target-coverage enumeration or formula reconstruction.

time_limit_note: Uninterrupted mode calls solve exactly once without conflict/propagation budgets or a Python timer. seconds_requested is advisory for the external watchdog, measured from search_started_monotonic in search_begin. The worker enforces no deadline. External termination proves neither SAT nor UNSAT.
feasibility_note: SAT proves only the independently checked candidate. UNSAT excludes only the stated capped finite-pool/fixed-row model. UNKNOWN proves neither.
